meta.title: Email & Marketing adjacent / marketing catalogue research
meta.pricingPolicy: Only prices published on official pages (or official help stating a floor price). No invented or third-party-only prices.

products.name: Bouncer
products.softShortDescription: Email verification and list hygiene platform for cleaner sends and stronger sender reputation.
products.shortDescription: Bouncer verifies email addresses via app and API, with optional real-time form protection (Shield), toxicity checks, and a Deliverability Kit for inbox placement and authentication testing.
products.vendorPositioning: Powerful, secure, and caring email verification — improve data quality, email marketing ROI, protect sign-up forms, and protect sender reputation.
products.pricingNotes: 100 free verification credits to start; no credit card required to start. Credits never expire. Official FAQ: not charged for duplicate addresses within a list or for 'unknown' results. Volume discounts on credit packs.

plans.name: Email Verification — 1,000 credits
plans.notes: Minimum purchase 1,000 credits

plans.name: Deliverability Kit — Starter
plans.notes: 250 test emails; 10 IPs/domains monitored

plans.name: Deliverability Kit — Standard
plans.notes: 1,000 test emails; 25 IPs/domains monitored

plans.name: Deliverability Kit — Pro
plans.notes: 2,500 test emails; 50 IPs/domains monitored

plans.name: Bouncer Shield (example tiers shown on pricing page)
plans.price: From ~$2/month (1,000 monthly checks) scaling with volume
plans.notes: Published calculator tiers include 1,000 checks → $2; 10,000 → $20; 50k/150k/250k volume tiers; 1,000,000 → $1,050. Exact total depends on selected monthly checks and options.

keyFeatures: Deliverability Kit (inbox placement, blocklist, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, SpamAssassin)
bestFor: Marketers cleaning lists before campaigns
Agencies and SaaS teams needing API verification
Teams protecting signup forms from bad/fraudulent emails
Senders monitoring domain/IP deliverability health
notIdealFor: Teams needing a full email campaign / ESP platform
Users who only need a personal inbox or email host
limitations: Not an email sending or campaign tool
Core verification is credit-based (not a single flat 'unlimited' plan)
Catch-all / unknown results still require judgment even with deep verification claims
products.classificationNotes: Email verification / list hygiene — adjacent to email marketing, not a core campaign ESP. Inventory already notes this. Fit as secondary/adjacent membership under email-marketing, not as a primary ESP comparison page peer.

products.name: InboxAlly
products.softShortDescription: Email deliverability and reputation repair via seed engagement and inbox placement tooling.
products.shortDescription: InboxAlly uses a seed engagement network and ML scoring to improve inbox placement, reverse spam/promotions misclassification, and warm or repair sender reputation without taking over ESP credentials.
products.vendorPositioning: Email deliverability software that teaches inbox providers your mail is wanted — repair-grade reputation work, not just new-domain warmup.
products.pricingModel: subscription (monthly tiers by seed volume / sender profiles)
products.pricingNotes: 10-day free trial, no credit card required. Free toolkit/tester available. Affiliate inventory notes a time-limited reader offer (verify before publishing): through 2026-12-01, 20% off first 3 months with code BFCM2025. Based in New York, USA.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 100 seed emails/day; 1 sender profile; email support

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: 500 seed emails/day; 5 sender profiles; email + live chat

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: 1,000 seed emails/day; 10 sender profiles; phone support; setup + weekly strategy sessions

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Thousands of seeds/day; unlimited sender profiles

keyFeatures: Native CRM integrations (HubSpot, Klaviyo, and more)
Works with any ESP/SMTP via seed list inclusion
bestFor: Senders with damaged domain reputation
High-volume marketers and cold outreach operators
Agencies managing multiple client sending domains
ESPs/experts adding deliverability tooling
notIdealFor: Teams that need an ESP to build/send campaigns
Very low-volume senders seeking a cheap warmup-only tool
Buyers expecting a complete fix inside a 10-day trial (vendor notes repair often takes weeks)
limitations: Not a campaign platform — complements an ESP
Pricing scales steeply with sender profiles and seed volume
Requires including seed addresses in sends
products.classificationNotes: Deliverability / warmup / reputation repair — adjacent to email marketing. Do not treat as a core ESP. Strong secondary/adjacent fit for email-marketing category.

products.name: SaneBox
products.softShortDescription: AI inbox management that filters, snoozes, and reminds — personal email productivity, not campaign sending.
products.shortDescription: SaneBox is an AI email management add-on that works with existing mail providers (Gmail, Microsoft 365, Fastmail, IMAP, etc.) to auto-sort unimportant mail, unsubscribe, snooze, and follow up.
products.vendorPositioning: Eliminate inbox clutter with SaneBox AI — spend 3–4 hours less per week managing email.
products.pricingModel: subscription (Snack / Lunch / Dinner; monthly, yearly, or bi-yearly)
products.pricingNotes: Official help states plans start at just $7/month with savings on annual billing. Exact Snack/Lunch/Dinner dollar amounts are shown on the pricing page UI but were not reliably extractable via crawl (JS-rendered). Homepage promotes 14-day free trial (no credit card); one help article also mentions a 7-day trial — treat as verify-at-checkout. Educational/non-profit/government: 25% discount (homepage FAQ).

plans.name: Snack
plans.price: Not published in crawlable text (starts-from $7/mo floor stated on help)
plans.notes: 1 email account; choose any 2 features

plans.name: Lunch
plans.price: Not published in crawlable text — see pricing page
plans.notes: 2 email accounts; wider feature set

plans.name: Dinner
plans.price: Not published in crawlable text — see pricing page
plans.notes: 4 email accounts; all features; contact support for more accounts

keyFeatures: Works with major clients via IMAP/OAuth — nothing to download
bestFor: Individuals and professionals drowning in personal/work inbox volume
Users of Gmail, Microsoft 365, Fastmail, or IMAP who want filtering without switching hosts
notIdealFor: Email marketers needing campaigns, automations, or list sending
Teams needing shared marketing CRM / ESP workflows
limitations: Not email marketing software
Public dollar prices for each tier not confirmed beyond $7/mo floor in this research pass
Requires granting mailbox access (OAuth/IMAP)
products.classificationNotes: Inbox productivity — inventory historically categoryHint email-marketing with adjacent note. Correct primary category is business-communications (or productivity), not email-marketing. Keep as adjacent only if cross-linked from email-marketing hygiene/productivity content; do not rank against ESPs.

products.name: Kartra
products.softShortDescription: All-in-one marketing and online business platform for funnels, email, courses, and checkouts.
products.shortDescription: Kartra combines landing pages, email/SMS marketing, memberships/courses, checkouts, funnels, AI copy, and related automation in one platform aimed at coaches, experts, and creators.
products.vendorPositioning: The all-in-one platform that turns your expertise into scalable income — replace 8–12 tools with one system.
products.pricingNotes: Homepage CTA: free trial. Pricing page: 30-day risk-free money-back guarantee; cancel anytime. Yearly billed rates shown as lower effective monthly prices. Essentials includes 5% transaction fees; Starter+ list 0% transaction fees.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: 500 contacts; 10,000 emails/month; 5 pages; 1 product; 1 membership/course; Kartra AI 30 uses; 5% transaction fees

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 2,500 contacts; unlimited email & SMS; unlimited pages/products/memberships; AI 100 uses; video hosting; 5 team members; 0% transaction fees

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: 12,500 contacts; automations; affiliates; surveys; 10 team members; helpdesk; 3 custom domains

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: 25,000 contacts; real-time funnel analytics; 5 custom domains; helpdesk live chat; AI 200 uses (comparison table)

bestFor: Coaches, consultants, and creators consolidating funnel + email + course stack
Solopreneurs wanting one platform vs many point tools
notIdealFor: Buyers who only need a lightweight ESP
Large B2B teams needing enterprise CRM depth as primary system
limitations: All-in-one breadth can be heavier than a dedicated ESP
Lower tiers have contact, page, and AI-use caps
Essentials charges transaction fees

products.vendorPositioning: Transform marketing to boost revenue growth — attract, nurture, and convert with AI-powered marketing automation.

Public pricing page (verified) shows Free and Enterprise only; older Growth/Pro contact tiers appear in third-party writeups but were not confirmed on the live official pricing page this pass — do not invent those prices. 21-day free trial, no credit card. Annual billing toggle (save 20%).

plans.name: Enterprise
